note: Draft topic pack generated from approved IELTS Core bundles. Review before learner-facing use.

bundles.sense: show or suggest clearly
bundles.englishDefinition: to show, point out, or suggest something clearly in data, reports, or discussion

contexts.text: Recent survey results indicate that online learning is becoming more common in higher education.
The chart indicates a steady rise in spending on digital infrastructure.
These figures indicate that many people now depend on technology in daily life.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "indicate" in one IELTS Task 1 sentence describing a trend.

bundles.sense: careful study that aims to discover facts or test ideas
bundles.englishDefinition: systematic study carried out to develop knowledge, test ideas, or solve problems

contexts.text: Recent research suggests that digital tools can improve access to education in remote areas.
Public research funding should focus on technologies that solve practical environmental problems.
I often read research about new technology before deciding whether it is genuinely useful.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "research" in an IELTS sentence about innovation or public funding.

bundles.sense: control something through rules or systems
bundles.englishDefinition: to control an activity or process by using rules or laws

contexts.text: Some people argue that governments should regulate social media platforms more carefully.
Stronger laws are needed to regulate industrial emissions in major cities.
I believe authorities should regulate new technologies before they spread too quickly.

productionPrompt.instruction: Write one IELTS-style sentence about why governments regulate something.

bundles.sense: usual, expected, or functioning in the standard way
bundles.englishDefinition: usual, expected, or operating in the standard way without unusual problems

contexts.text: After a software update, users expect the device to return to normal operation quickly.
Heavy dependence on mobile phones may make constant connectivity seem normal to younger generations.
For me, using online services for study and shopping has become a normal part of daily life.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "normal" in one IELTS-style sentence about technology use, digital habits, or system performance.

bundles.sense: make something new happen or exist
bundles.englishDefinition: to make something new, or to cause a situation or effect to exist

contexts.text: Digital platforms can create new opportunities for small businesses.
Heavy traffic can create serious problems for people living in city centres.
Technology has created more flexible ways to study and work.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "create" in one IELTS-style sentence about a social or technological change.

bundles.sense: to plan or create something for a particular purpose
bundles.englishDefinition: To plan and create a product, system, course, or solution for a specific purpose.
bundles.chineseMeaning: & vi.设计；绘制 vt.设计；计划

contexts.text: Engineers must design devices that use less energy without reducing performance.
Governments should design policies that encourage innovation in public services.
I would like to design a study space that helps students concentrate better.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "design" in one IELTS-style sentence about improving technology or public services.

bundles.sense: the purpose or role of something
bundles.englishDefinition: The purpose, role, or practical use of something within a system or process.

contexts.text: The main function of the software is to organise large amounts of data efficiently.
One function of higher education is to prepare students for changing labour markets.
My phone has one useful function that helps me manage my study schedule.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "function" in one IELTS-style sentence explaining the purpose of a tool or institution.

bundles.sense: recognise or find something important
bundles.englishDefinition: to recognise, discover, or point out something clearly

contexts.text: Researchers can now identify patterns in large amounts of digital data.
Policy makers must identify the main causes of traffic congestion before taking action.
It is sometimes hard to identify reliable information online.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "identify" in a sentence about solving a public problem.

bundles.sense: to find the exact position of something
bundles.englishDefinition: To find or identify the exact position of someone or something.
bundles.chineseMeaning: 位于；说出来源；查找…的地点

contexts.text: Scientists used satellite images to locate areas affected by flooding.
Sensors can help city authorities locate faults in public infrastructure more quickly.
I use a map app to locate new places when I travel to unfamiliar cities.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "locate" in one IELTS-style sentence about maps, data, or modern technology.

bundles.sense: a series of actions taken to achieve a result
bundles.englishDefinition: A series of steps or actions that lead to a particular result.

contexts.text: The diagram shows the process of recycling household waste into new materials.
A transparent recruitment process can improve trust in public institutions.
Learning a language is a gradual process that requires regular practice.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "process" in one IELTS-style sentence describing how something works or changes.

bundles.sense: a number of different things of the same general type
bundles.englishDefinition: A set or variety of things that differ within clear limits.

contexts.text: The website offers a wide range of online courses for adult learners.
Cities should invest in a range of transport options rather than relying on cars alone.
My university library provides a range of digital resources that students use every day.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "range" in one IELTS-style sentence about options, resources, or services.

bundles.sense: need something as a condition or necessity
bundles.englishDefinition: to need something or make it necessary

contexts.text: Modern industries require workers to update their skills regularly.
Expanding public transport will require substantial government funding.
Learning to use new software often requires patience.

productionPrompt.instruction: Write one sentence explaining why a change would require support or funding.

bundles.sense: to obtain something important or make something safe
bundles.englishDefinition: To obtain something important or to make something safe and protected.
bundles.chineseMeaning: 安全的；牢固的；有把握的

contexts.text: Small firms often struggle to secure enough funding for research and development.
Universities must secure student data before expanding online services.
I worked hard to secure a scholarship because tuition fees were expensive.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "secure" in one IELTS-style sentence about funding, data, or opportunities.

bundles.sense: to move something from one place, person, or system to another
bundles.englishDefinition: To move something from one place, person, or system to another

contexts.text: Recent studies show that organisations and users often transfer skills when dealing with innovation and access.
Governments should transfer data if they want to improve outcomes in technology and digital systems.
I think institutions need to transfer knowledge in order to respond effectively to innovation and access.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "transfer" in one IELTS-style sentence about technology and digital systems.

bundles.sense: put money, time, or effort into something for future benefit
bundles.englishDefinition: to spend money, time, or energy on something in order to gain a future benefit
bundles.chineseMeaning: & vi.投资；花费 vt.授予；使就职

contexts.text: Many countries invest in digital infrastructure to support economic growth.
Governments should invest more in research if they want to remain competitive.
I think families should invest time in helping children develop healthy habits.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "invest" in one IELTS-style sentence about money, time, or infrastructure.

bundles.sense: a level or part that covers or forms part of something
bundles.englishDefinition: A level or part that covers or forms part of something

contexts.text: The report identifies data layer as a major issue in technology and digital systems.
Policy should address surface layer if governments want to improve innovation and access.
In my view, layer is important because it shapes innovation and access.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "layer" in one IELTS-style sentence about technology and digital systems.

bundles.sense: make information available to the public
bundles.englishDefinition: to produce and make information, writing, or results available to the public

contexts.text: Researchers often publish their findings in open-access journals.
Public agencies should publish clearer data on air quality.
It is now much easier for ordinary people to publish content online.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "publish" in a sentence about information or research.

bundles.sense: depend on someone or something
bundles.englishDefinition: to depend on someone or something for support or success

contexts.text: Modern businesses rely heavily on digital communication tools.
Cities cannot rely solely on private cars to solve transport demand.
Many students rely on online sources when preparing assignments.

productionPrompt.instruction: Write one sentence explaining why people rely on something.

bundles.sense: to get something from a source or to come from that source
bundles.englishDefinition: to get something from a particular source, or to come from that source

contexts.text: Much of this evidence is derived from long-term studies of urban life.
Many students derive confidence from regular feedback on their work.
I derive most of my news from online sources rather than printed newspapers.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "derive" in one IELTS-style sentence about the source of an idea, benefit, or result.

bundles.sense: made of many connected parts and therefore difficult to understand or deal with
bundles.englishDefinition: made of many connected parts, ideas, or causes, so it is difficult to understand or deal with
bundles.chineseMeaning: 复杂的；难懂的；复合的 n.建筑群

contexts.text: Climate change is a complex issue with social, economic, and scientific dimensions.
Modern transport systems are becoming more complex as cities expand.
I think online privacy has become a more complex problem than it was ten years ago.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "complex" in one IELTS-style sentence about a modern problem or system.

bundles.sense: possible when developed or supported
bundles.englishDefinition: possible to develop, achieve, or become something in the future
bundles.chineseMeaning: 潜在的；有可能的；可能语气的

contexts.text: Artificial intelligence has the potential to improve medical diagnosis.
Online courses have the potential to widen access to education.
This idea has potential, but it still needs careful planning.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "potential" in a sentence about a future benefit or risk.

bundles.sense: related to specialised practical knowledge, especially science or technology
bundles.englishDefinition: Related to specialised practical knowledge, especially in science, engineering, or technology.
bundles.chineseMeaning: 技术性的；工艺的；学术上的

contexts.text: Many employers now expect graduates to combine communication skills with technical knowledge.
Governments should expand technical training to prepare workers for automation.
I would like to improve my technical skills because digital tools are used in almost every job.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "technical" in one IELTS-style sentence about skills, training, or modern industry.

bundles.sense: facts or information collected for reference or analysis
bundles.englishDefinition: facts or pieces of information that are collected and used for study, comparison, or decision-making

contexts.text: Researchers collected data from several schools before drawing any conclusions.
Governments need reliable data to plan transport and energy policy effectively.
I am more likely to trust a report when it uses clear data rather than vague claims.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "data" in one IELTS-style sentence about research, planning, or digital technology.

bundles.sense: a group of things or people with shared features
bundles.englishDefinition: a type or group of things that share similar features or qualities

contexts.text: The survey divided online users into age-based categories for comparison.
The largest category of household waste shown in the chart is plastic packaging.
I usually put my expenses into different categories so I can manage my budget better.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "category" in one IELTS-style sentence about classification, charts, or organised information.

bundles.sense: one of the parts of a larger whole
bundles.englishDefinition: One of the parts of a larger whole
bundles.chineseMeaning: 组成部分，成分；元件，组件

contexts.text: The report identifies key component as a major issue in technology and digital systems.
Policy should address major component if governments want to improve innovation and access.
In my view, component is important because it shapes innovation and access.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "component" in one IELTS-style sentence about technology and digital systems.

bundles.sense: the basic systems and services a society needs to function
bundles.englishDefinition: the essential physical and organisational structures such as transport, energy, and digital networks

contexts.text: Rural areas need better digital infrastructure if students are to benefit from online learning.
Investment in transport infrastructure can improve productivity and reduce regional inequality.
Modern infrastructure makes a city more efficient and more attractive to skilled workers.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "infrastructure" in one formal sentence about development, transport, or technology.

bundles.sense: an obstacle that prevents progress or communication
bundles.englishDefinition: An obstacle, problem, or difficulty that prevents progress, access, or communication
bundles.chineseMeaning: 障碍，壁垒；阻碍进步或交流的事物

contexts.text: High tuition fees can become a major barrier to university access for low-income students.
Governments should remove practical barriers that prevent small firms from adopting new technology.
In speaking tasks, candidates often mention the language barrier when describing life in another country.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "barrier" in one IELTS-style sentence about a problem that limits access or progress.

bundles.sense: the exchange of information, ideas, or feelings
bundles.englishDefinition: the process of sharing information or ideas between people, groups, or devices

contexts.text: Digital tools have changed the speed and style of communication at work.
Good communication between teachers and parents can improve student outcomes.
Video calls have made communication with relatives abroad much easier.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "communication" in one IELTS-style sentence about technology, education, or everyday interaction.

bundles.sense: when compared with something else
bundles.englishDefinition: when compared with another thing or situation

contexts.text: Online learning is comparatively cheap once the system has been built.
Rural housing remains comparatively affordable in some regions.
Public transport is comparatively reliable in my city.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "comparatively" in a sentence making a comparison.

bundles.sense: by using electronic systems, devices, or digital networks
bundles.englishDefinition: by using electronic systems, devices, or digital networks rather than paper-based or face-to-face methods

contexts.text: Patient records can be stored electronically to improve access across different departments.
Many applications are now submitted electronically, which reduces paperwork and processing time.
I prefer paying electronically because it is faster and easier to track.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "electronically" in one IELTS-style sentence about digital services, records, or payments.

bundles.sense: to connect two groups or reduce the difference between them
bundles.englishDefinition: to connect two groups, ideas, or systems, or to reduce the gap between them

contexts.text: Policy makers hope new training schemes will bridge the skills gap between graduates and employers.
Digital tools can help bridge the gap between rural schools and urban educational resources.
In my view, public transport projects should bridge isolated communities with city services.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "bridge" in one IELTS-style sentence about reducing a gap between people, systems, or opportunities.

bundles.sense: to plan or invent something carefully
bundles.englishDefinition: To plan or invent something carefully

contexts.text: Recent studies show that organisations and users often devise a plan when dealing with innovation and access.
Governments should devise solutions if they want to improve outcomes in technology and digital systems.
I think institutions need to devise a system in order to respond effectively to innovation and access.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "devise" in one IELTS-style sentence about technology and digital systems.

bundles.sense: capable of working successfully in practice
bundles.englishDefinition: Capable of working successfully in practice
bundles.chineseMeaning: 切实可行的,能养活的,能自行生产发育的,有望实现的

contexts.text: A viable issue in technology and digital systems is whether policy can improve innovation and access.
It is viable for governments to support long-term improvements in innovation and access.
I think viable changes are needed if society wants better results in technology and digital systems.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "viable" in one IELTS-style sentence about technology and digital systems.

bundles.sense: combined so that all parts work together effectively
bundles.englishDefinition: Combined so that all parts work together effectively
bundles.chineseMeaning: 综合的，整合的；一体化的

contexts.text: The city introduced an integrated transport system that connects buses, trains, and bike-sharing services.
An integrated approach to urban planning can reduce congestion while improving access to public services.
I prefer integrated apps because they allow people to study, communicate, and organise tasks in one place.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "integrated" in one IELTS-style sentence about systems, services, or planning that work together effectively.

bundles.sense: the arrival or beginning of something important
bundles.englishDefinition: The arrival or beginning of something important
bundles.chineseMeaning: 出现,到来,基督降临节（圣诞节前的四个星期）

contexts.text: The report identifies advent of AI as a major issue in technology and digital systems.
Policy should address advent of the internet if governments want to improve innovation and access.
In my view, advent is important because it shapes innovation and access.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "advent" in one IELTS-style sentence about technology and digital systems.

bundles.sense: to increase quickly in number and spread through an area, system, or society
bundles.englishDefinition: To increase rapidly in number and spread widely through a place, system, or field.
bundles.chineseMeaning: 激增，扩散；在某个地区、系统或领域中迅速增加并广泛传播

contexts.text: Online misinformation can proliferate quickly when users share content without checking the original source.
If electric vehicles proliferate over the next decade, cities may experience lower urban noise and cleaner air.
In my country, digital payment apps have proliferated because they are fast, convenient, and widely accepted.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "proliferate" in one IELTS-style sentence about something increasing rapidly in society or technology.

bundles.sense: to change something completely so that it becomes much better, more modern, or more effective
bundles.englishDefinition: To change something greatly so that it becomes very different, often more modern, efficient, or effective.

contexts.text: Affordable internet access can transform education by widening access to online materials.
Public investment in research can transform an economy from resource-based growth to innovation-led growth.
Technology has transformed the way I study because I can organise notes and practise listening on my phone.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "transform" in one IELTS-style sentence about technology, education, or social change.

bundles.sense: 演变，发展
bundles.englishDefinition: To develop or change gradually over time into a more advanced or different form.

contexts.text: Communication methods continue to evolve as mobile technology becomes cheaper and more widely available.
Education systems must evolve if they are to prepare students for a labour market shaped by automation.
I think public transport apps will evolve further because passengers now expect live updates and digital payment options.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "evolve" in one IELTS-style sentence about technology, education, or public services changing over time.

bundles.sense: 出现，浮现
bundles.englishDefinition: To appear or become known, especially after a period of change, growth, or uncertainty.

contexts.text: New privacy concerns often emerge when governments collect more personal data through digital services.
If new industries emerge in rural regions, fewer young adults may feel forced to move to major cities.
Interesting career options keep emerging in my city as more companies invest in software and green energy.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "emerge" in one IELTS-style sentence about a new trend, concern, or opportunity appearing.

bundles.sense: the use of machines or software to do tasks with little or no direct human control
bundles.englishDefinition: The use of machines, software, or digital systems to perform tasks automatically with reduced human input.
bundles.chineseMeaning: 自动化；利用机器、软件或数字系统在较少人工干预下完成任务

contexts.text: The spread of automation in factories has increased productivity but reduced demand for some routine jobs.
Governments should prepare workers for automation by funding retraining programmes in digital and technical skills.
I use automation in daily life when apps remind me about bills, appointments, and repeated online tasks.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "automation" in one IELTS-style sentence about work, industry, or everyday technology.

bundles.sense: a new idea, method, or product that improves something
bundles.englishDefinition: A new idea, method, or technology that improves how something is done; the process of introducing such changes
bundles.chineseMeaning: 创新，革新；新方法、新技术或新产品

contexts.text: Rapid innovation in mobile payment systems has changed how consumers and small businesses operate.
Public funding can support innovation, but governments should still regulate the risks created by new technologies.
The most useful innovation in my daily life is cloud storage because it makes study materials easier to access.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "innovation" in one IELTS-style sentence about technology, business, or public policy.

bundles.sense: 突破
bundles.englishDefinition: An important discovery or development that leads to major progress in a field.

contexts.text: A major medical breakthrough can improve life expectancy, but the treatment is often expensive at first.
Technological breakthroughs should be shared fairly so that poorer regions also benefit from scientific progress.
The most impressive recent breakthrough for me is translation software that makes international study much easier.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "breakthrough" in one IELTS-style sentence about science, medicine, or technology.

bundles.sense: the quality of being connected, especially through transport, communication, or digital networks
bundles.englishDefinition: The quality of being connected, especially through the internet, mobile systems, transport links, or shared networks.

contexts.text: Poor connectivity in remote areas can limit access to online classes, banking, and medical advice.
Improving rural connectivity should be a priority if governments want economic growth to be more balanced.
Reliable connectivity matters to me because weak mobile data makes studying and paying bills much harder.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "connectivity" in one IELTS-style sentence about internet access, infrastructure, or regional inequality.

bundles.sense: 人工的
bundles.englishDefinition: Made by people rather than occurring naturally, or created by technology to copy something natural.

contexts.text: Artificial lighting allows factories and offices to operate for longer hours, but it also increases energy use.
Artificial intelligence may improve public services, yet it also raises concerns about privacy and job security.
I would like to try a course on artificial intelligence because it is already affecting how people study and work.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "artificial" in one IELTS-style sentence about intelligence, materials, or lighting.

bundles.sense: related to computers, the internet, or electronic technology
bundles.englishDefinition: Relating to computers, the internet, or electronic technology; involving digital signals or data
bundles.chineseMeaning: 数字的，数码的；与计算机或电子技术相关的

contexts.text: The digital divide remains a serious problem in regions where schools still lack reliable internet access.
Digital services can save time, but governments must ensure that older people are not excluded.
Most students now submit assignments through digital platforms instead of printing everything.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "digital" in one IELTS-style sentence about technology, services, or education.

bundles.sense: 虚拟的
bundles.englishDefinition: Existing or happening mainly on computers or online rather than in a physical place.

contexts.text: Virtual classrooms helped many universities continue teaching when students could not attend in person.
Virtual meetings reduce travel costs, although they cannot fully replace direct human interaction.
I sometimes prefer virtual events because they save time and make it easier to join from home.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "virtual" in one IELTS-style sentence about classes, meetings, or online experiences.

bundles.sense: 自主的
bundles.englishDefinition: Able to operate independently or with little direct human control.

contexts.text: Autonomous vehicles rely on sensors and software to make driving decisions in real time.
Governments should test autonomous transport carefully before allowing it to spread on public roads.
I would be cautious about using an autonomous taxi until the technology becomes more reliable.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "autonomous" in one IELTS-style sentence about vehicles, machines, or independent systems.

bundles.sense: 迅速发展的
bundles.englishDefinition: Growing or developing very quickly.

contexts.text: The burgeoning market for electric vehicles has encouraged governments to invest in charging infrastructure.
A burgeoning tourism industry can create jobs, but it may also put pressure on local housing and transport.
There is a burgeoning interest in online courses in my area because flexible learning suits working adults.

productionPrompt.instruction: Use "burgeoning" in one IELTS-style sentence about a rapidly growing market, industry, or trend.
